abstract: Six cases of testicular tumors in children are presented: 3 patients had teratoma, 1 embryonal carcinoma, 1 orchioblastoma, and 1 paratesticular rhabdomyosarcoma. Three of the 6 patients presented with hydroceles. The treatment consisted of orchiectomy alone. All patients were alive and free of disease one and one-half to eight and one-half years after orchiectomy. It is suggested that orchiectomy alone is curative in most children with testicular tumors under the age of two years.
abstract_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍の6症例を報告する。奇形腫3例、胎児性癌1例、精巣芽腫1例、精巣傍横紋筋肉腫1例であった。3例は水瘤を呈していた。全例が精巣摘除術のみで治療され、精巣摘除術後1年半から8年半にわたり無病生存している。2歳未満の小児では、精巣摘除術のみで多くの精巣腫瘍が治癒し得ると考えられる。
